      4. Deleted items are not displayed

    3. ‘A-Z' button is active if user has permission 'Edit Product Groups nomenclature'

    5. ‘Remove' icon is active if user has permission ‘Edit Product Groups nomenclature’

      1. Number of records dropdowns will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

      1. It is possible to search by name, name transliterated

    • Footer is always fixed to bottom, so Search box, number of records and pagination is not hidden on scrolling

    • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter or leave the field will directly load that page. If page number is not valid or does not exist the field should be cleared after clicking on Enter or leave the field

    • Sort order will be used for displaying items in dropdowns in system

    • Newly added item will always be added as last item

      • After ordering alphabetically user will be able to modify ordering manually using drag and drop within the page, no possibility to drag & drop between pages

      2. Name (Transliterated)

        1. Mandatory

        2. Type: Text area

        3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed 

        4. Length 1-512 characters

        5. While typing Group name, value will be automatically filled using transliterated rules:

          1. Transliteration Rules.xlsx

        6. It is possible to update automatically added value

    • if user have only Viewing permission, in Pop-up window will be disabled editing option

  • To be able to remove item from nomenclature

    3. It is possible to delete default nomenclature item and no need to preselect value automatically (user must update manually if needed to set new default value)

Currency

User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to create and manage nomenclature for ‘currencies’

So that I will have possibility to change values without system deployment

  • Max two currencies (with active and inactive statuses) record can be created in system

    1. Deleted nomenclatures count is not limited

  • It is possible to save currency without marking as Main currency; if in nomenclature Main currency doesn't exist in billing run will be reported such error

  • It is possible to save alternative currency without marking currency as Main currency (in this case alternative currency is not used anywhere in the system)

  • It is possible to save alternative currencies for both nomenclatures:

    1. E.g. Euro could be alternative currency for Leva with exchange rate 0.5 AND at the same time Leva could be alternative currency for Euro with different exchange rate 0.6

  • It is possible to have more than one main currency in system (Both currencies will have set start date and they should not be equal)

  • Both currencies can be editable and all fields can be edited:

    1. Start date can be editable for both main currencies and last entered date will be always valid

    2. It is possible to edit Main currency checkbox and mark nomenclature as Main currency or remove Main currency

      1. If removed Main currency checkbox start date will be removed from that nomenclature

    3. It is possible in editing process to remove alternative currency

      1. If removed alternative currency exchange rate will be also removed

    4. It is possible to edit exchange rate between currencies

      1. The last entered value will always be used in billing and no need to determine exact date from where this rate was changed (no need to calculate previous period with old exchange rate)

  • It is possible to remove currency from system:

    1. Main currency can not be removed. It must first be edited to remove Main currency checkbox and then remove

  • Alternative currency can not be removed - It must first be removed from the Main currency

  • It is possible to mark currency as default:

    1. In system currency's dropdown will be selected by default. If there is no default value, Main currency should be preselected as default in dropdowns. If both checkboxes are selected than default will be preselected

  • It is possible to mark currency as inactive

    1. In system inactive currency will not be listed in dropdown

    2. In editing if default nomenclature item is marked as inactive system should automatically remove it and disable ‘default’ checkbox

  • There is no connection between Main currency checkbox and the other checkboxes (inactive, default)

  • In system if currency doesn't exists and dropdown for currency is empty will return error while saving object

  • Name should be unique and shouldn't be case sensitive

    1. Leva and LEVA can't be saved both

  • Nomenclature name should be ‘Price component Value types'

  • Not to be able to edit/delete nomenclature name

  • Selecting 'Price component Value types' in the nomenclature dropdown will do following:

    1. In right panel list of nomenclature items will be loaded:

      1. Name is displayed in the list

      2. Blue color for active items

      3. Red color for inactive items

      4. Deleted items are not displayed

    2. 'Plus' button is active if user has permission 'Create Price component Value types nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    3. ‘A-Z' button is active if user has permission 'Edit Price component Value types nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    4. 'A (Move to top)' icon is active if user has permission 'Edit Price component Value types nomenclature'

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    5. ‘Remove' icon is active if user has permission ‘Edit Price component Value types nomenclature’

      1. if no use disabled state (gray color)

    6. Pagination will always appear

      1. Number of records dropdowns will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

      2. 25 is selected by default

    7. Search box will appear in footer

      1. It is possible to search by name

      2. By default search icon is gray and becomes active after typing 1 symbol in search box

      3. Clicking on ‘Search’ Icon will run search

      4. 'X' button next to search icon will clear search results and will empty the search field

      5. Changing the nomenclature will empty the search field

  • Scroll/Pagination

    • Footer is always fixed to bottom, so Search box, number of records and pagination is not hidden on scrolling

    • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter or leave the field will directly load that page. If page number is not valid or does not exist the field should be cleared after clicking on Enter or leave the field

    • ‘Plus’ button/'A-Z' icon is displayed in each page and page is scrollable

  • Update order of added nomenclature items:

    • Sort order will be used for displaying items in dropdowns in system

    • Newly added item will always be added as last item

    • Clicking on ‘A-Z’ icon will reorder all items alphabetically. 

      • After ordering alphabetically user will be able to modify ordering manually using drag and drop within the page, no possibility to drag & drop between pages

      • ‘Move To Top’ icon will move selected item First in the list and all other items order will be shifted by one

      • in search results state Drag & Drop action is not active; Only ‘Move to Top’ action will be active

  • To able to add nomenclature items by ‘Plus’ button:

    1. Values to be added:

      1. Name

        1. Mandatory

        2. Unique (to have unique value under active and inactive statuses; it is possible to have more than one duplicated name under Deleted status)

        3. Type: Text area

        4. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

        5. Length 1-512 characters

  • To be able to edit nomenclature item name

    • if user have only Viewing permission, in Pop-up window will be disabled editing option

  • To be able to remove item from nomenclature

    1. Should display message:

      1. Clicking on Yes will remove nomenclature

      2. Clicking on Cancel will close popup

    2. if an object is connected to this nomenclature item in system nomenclature can’t be deleted

      1. e.g. if Product is connected to this object first should update Product to add another value and then will be possible to remove.

      2. Display Warning message ''

  • To be able to make nomenclature item inactive

    1. No matter object e.g. Product is connected or not we need possibility to mark status as inactive.

      1. In create Product page inactive item will not be visible in dropdown

      2. In edit Product page will be visible but clicking on a dropdown to edit will load only active items, so will not be able to see inactive values in the dropdown itself

  • To be able to set nomenclature item as default, so default value will be preselected on dropdown

    1. It is possible to have only one Default value in nomenclature

    2. If default value is not selected, then in nomenclature dropdown will not be preselected:

    3. It is possible to delete default nomenclature item and no need to preselect value automatically (user must update manually if needed to set new default value)

    4. In editing if default nomenclature item is marked as inactive system should automatically remove it and disable ‘default’ checkbox

  • Audit Log

    • Audit Log record should be created on adding/Editing/Removing actions 

    • No need to create Audit Log record on Move to top/Drag & Drop
